Fresh Sol/Ultra reviewer, one task and one exact head. Work read-only in
/tmp/qpbt-conditioned-pasting-defect-20260909 (the repository worktree entry
issue-463-conditioned-pasting-defect is a symlink to it), clean/public head
a72c8dbb1778288b4297cfb05cb6e0fbda068554, PR465/issue463.
MAIN retargeted the obsolete merged-parent base to main after checking
ancestry; no candidate content changed. Trusted published-main policy pin:
bff096a94fa3d92b1b6f264364dcdbe6b44cdecc. Use PRIMARY local/bin tools only.

Read reviewer/prose-reviewer personas, the four .github/prompts review files,
review.md, CONTRIBUTING section5, AGENTS faithfulness/integrity rules,
anti_patterns and mathematical_language FROM THE TRUSTED PIN. Fresh-session
independence applies regardless of model family; you have not authored or
repaired this PR or issue. No branch edits, commits, publication, ledger edits,
statuses/reviews/comments, gate invocation, merge, full build/CI, rendering,
cache resets, other-worktree writes, keys, lanes, codex exec, dispatch.sh,
review.sh, autofix, chsh or descendants. Temporary report artifacts only.

FOUR genuine full reviews are preserved:
- 5155651366 at d202314f1a3d899c5fc5ae591ba9694c3544c3e0: approved code.
- 5185502257 at af0e3f30ee21b2a49beb4516d6f95040316b9226: approved code.
- 5185842369 at990eab1e9a5b6cfd62ca0d567a1372cb74467c5c: prose changes.
- 5199615458 at7bd5558d489e404ee8631b779ca73ec1896810fd: code approved,
  prose changes, eight unchecked findings F1-F8.
Actual records and strict hash comparisons are saved in
/tmp/pr465-terminal-review-input-20260917.json. MAIN found no patch identity
with any genuine review, so automatic approval carry is unavailable. This
is the bounded terminal assessment authorized by review.md section12, not a
fifth full-review/fix loop. Preserve prior dispositions and costs, do not grow
scope or reopen settled issues without new evidence.

Read issue463 and source paper passages before assessing the six-file current
main-relative contribution (+690/-15). It consists of auxiliary blueprint
coverage in chapters12/15/16 and comments in QPBT.lean, WitnessMarginals.lean,
SupportMass.lean. The conditioning theorem is now already on main; the helper
removed only the duplicate old ConditionedPastingDefect module/import and kept
the current Conditioning declaration reachable through Construction. Verify
this integration preserved incoming proofs, imports and source-gap statuses.

The old read-only mapping /tmp/pr465-recovery-20260917-report.md is a lead,
not independent evidence for this final head. The current owner helper receipt
is the opus-fix-pr465-20260917-01 row of primary owner-sessions.jsonl. Recheck
F1-F8 against actual current declarations and paper/blueprint:
F1 separate X/Z arbitrary-witness marginal bounds, directed opposite placements,
squared4deltaQ, no unrestricted source line theorem completion;
F2 separate pointwise/averaged support mass bounds, arbitrary state and complete
POVMs, nonnegative arbitrary weights, no gratuitous normalization, separate
from quantitative nonencoding mass completion;
F3 correct padded-state quadratic-form support and compression dependency;
F4 actual restricted-average and integrand-positivity dependencies for the
conditioning bound, reconciled with current conditioning/restoration coverage;
F5 decoder-linearity dependency for bounded encoding;
F6 controlled-unitary mathematical module prose;
F7 combined-point/witness prose and no runtime-limit narration;
F8 standard codeword-defect/nonencoding-mass/consistency terminology.
Read source section14 relevant passages899-963,1277-1289,1483-1498 and section4
882-897 with surrounding definitions, plus any other passage actually cited.
Preserve source combined-line/padding obligations and existing unfaithful or
conditional boundaries. A support node is not a new paper theorem proof.

All nine exact-head CI contexts pass. Rooted compiled audit at
~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/ci-logs/465/a72c8dbb1778288b4297cfb05cb6e0fbda068554/
blueprint-leanok-axioms.log gives PASS1638 FAIL0 WARN4 statement-only, no
proof-level sorryAx. Installed hooks/warm setup and clean head were checked.
Reuse this evidence; no duplicate CI/build/render/audit. Focused read-only
queries or single-file Lean checks only if needed to resolve a concrete doubt.

Return /tmp/pr465-terminal-assessment-20260917-comment.md with canonical
exact-head marker, precise F1-F8 disposition ledger, source/statement integrity,
checks/limits and a parseable final VERDICT. Cover both code and prose lanes;
approval requires zero unchecked findings. If a genuine residual remains,
report it precisely without inventing a scope-growing implementation task.
MAIN validates the actual posted record and publishes summary later.

The current PR title/body are stale auto-generated commit-history prose. Draft
an accurate conventional title and Motivation/Description/Testing body in
/tmp/pr465-terminal-assessment-20260917-pr-body.md, with a separate title file.
Describe the final six-file mathematical-documentation contribution, completed
checks and remaining source obligations. Do not infer issue463 closure from
its title alone; retain the single appropriate Addresses/Closes footer only
after comparing the actual issue criteria. No external mutations by you.
Also return a concise receipt and computed SHA256 manifest.

Budget900 seconds, including final180 for the short review/receipt artifacts;
absolute UTC deadline is supplied at spawn. One task then retire. Do not spend
the budget on a new global review search, new tests, or historical archaeology
beyond the existing findings and final integration. Stop truthfully at deadline.

## Code review

Reviewed the authoritative on-disk patch at `990eab1e9a5b6cfd62ca0d567a1372cb74467c5c`, including material truncated from the attachment. The prior ledger contains no findings.

The conditioning estimate correctly recovers the original sample order, derives nonnegativity from opposite placements, and divides by a proved positive retained mass. Compression, rounding transport, and encoding support establish the documented auxiliary results without adding proof-obligation hypotheses to paper theorems.

`pauli_soundness_qubit` preserves the assumptions, quantifier order, parameter bounds, and three error conclusions of `cor:pauli-binary` in `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1470`. Its proof follows the cited coordinate transport. Verdict: faithful boundary encoding.

`not_exists_combining_quarter_power_bound` matches its separate blueprint statement. The admissible sequence proves the scalar obstruction, and the paper-gap addition correctly distinguishes that obstruction from refuting extended-line existence.

Ten focused Lean file checks passed without diagnostics; the proof-integrity scan and `git diff --check` passed. Checked auxiliary axiom closures contain only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.

Residual proof debt remains explicit: `pauli_soundness_qubit` inherits `sorryAx` from `pauli_soundness`, tracked by #529; the extended-line existence obligations remain open. These are documented existing obligations. Full build and blueprint rendering were not rerun. The installed `lean-conventions` skill was unavailable; repository integrity and convention documents were reviewed.

## Prose review

F1: The new conditioning theorem and its distribution/mass results have no blueprint links. The same omission affects the public results in `GroundCompression.lean`, `RoundingTransport.lean`, and `EncodingSupport.lean`, and `tensorMeasurement_postprocess`. Only the scalar obstruction receives a new blueprint entry.

Add subordinate auxiliary entries stating their actual hypotheses and conclusions, with `\lean`, appropriate status markers, and accurate `\uses` dependencies. In particular, record the conditioned consistency bound with its opposite-placement hypothesis and inverse retained-mass factor. These entries must remain separate from the unfinished combined-line, global polynomial-pair, and quantitative encoding-support assertions.

The scalar obstruction’s blueprint statement matches `IsPolyErr₂` and the Lean quantifiers. The qubit corollary retains its source-faithful signature; withholding proof-level `\leanok` remains correct because qudit soundness is unfinished.

## Findings

Checkbox states: `[ ]` unresolved (blocks the merge), `[x]` resolved.
Resolve a finding by ticking its box in this review body.

<!-- findings:begin -->
- [ ] F1 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/WitnessMarginals.lean:37` — Add separate blueprint nodes for the two new public marginal-distance theorems.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F2 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/SupportMass.lean:41` — Add separate blueprint nodes for the two new public support-mass comparison theorems.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F3 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:2682` — Correct the proof dependency: Lean calls the padded-state quadratic-form lemma, not `lem:ground-compress-effect`.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F4 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1086` — Add the restricted-average and consistency-integrand positivity results actually used by the conditioned-defect proof.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F5 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:367` — Record `lem:qld-decoder-linearity` in the proof dependencies for bounded encodings.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F6 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean:92` — Replace the banned “re-exported” and namespace/import prose with mathematical wording.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F7 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/WitnessMarginals.lean:7` — Replace the Lean identifier and runtime-limit comments with mathematical prose.  <!-- lane=prose -->
- [ ] F8 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/SupportMass.lean:13` — Replace Lean declaration identifiers in the documentation with the corresponding mathematical statements.  <!-- lane=prose -->
<!-- findings:end -->

## Code review

The prior F1 is resolved: `lem:qld-conditioned-pasting-defect` now provides a dedicated blueprint entry whose statement matches `consistencyDefect_nondegenerateLinePastingDist_le`.

The theorem correctly reconstructs the original sample order after conditioning and applies the restriction bound to a pointwise nonnegative consistency integrand. Opposite placements provide the required commutation and positivity. It is clearly presented as a formalization-only auxiliary, not as `eq:pasting-q1`, and introduces no proof-debt hypotheses or source-statement drift.

The additional blueprint entries reviewed match their Lean declarations, including the rounding constants and quantifier order. The replacement combined-points paper-gap note is self-contained, accurately distinguishes the field-valued proof from the source’s binary-refinement route, and gives a clear fidelity verdict.

Targeted Lean checks and `git diff --check` succeeded. The warning in `Combining/Lines.lean` comes from the unchanged `combined_line_measurement_consistency` sorry, which is explicitly documented as the known proof obligation tracked by issues #18 and #414.

## Prose review

**F1.** Neither `CombinedPointsWitness.marginal_X_distance_le` nor its Z analogue appears in the blueprint. Add subordinate formalization-support nodes stating the actual generality: an arbitrary combined-point witness, directed opposite placements, and squared-distance bound `4δQ`. Do not add `\leanok` to `lem:qld-xz-lines`, which remains unfinished.

**F2.** The two public support-mass comparisons are likewise absent. Add subordinate nodes under the encoding-support material, preserving their arbitrary-vector and not-necessarily-normalized-distribution generality. These nodes must remain separate from `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`; they do not justify completing that source-labelled result.

**F3.** The proof metadata lists `lem:ground-compress-effect`, but the Lean proof at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/GroundCompression.lean:91` directly applies `stateQForm_padState` and does not invoke that lemma. Record the padded-state quadratic-form result as a subordinate node and use that label; remove the current edge unless the formal proof actually uses it.

**F4.** The proof at `ConditionedPastingDefect.lean:45-48` unfolds the conditioned law and directly applies `avgOver_restrict_le_div_mass` and `consistencyDefect_integrand_nonneg`. The current `\uses` records only positive retained mass. Add nodes and edges for the two actual mathematical inputs.

**F5.** `isEncoding_encodingPoly` is proved by unfolding encoding membership and applying `decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding` at `EncodingSupport.lean:45-46`. That theorem is already represented by `lem:qld-decoder-linearity`, so the proof block needs a corresponding `\uses`.

**F6.** The phrase “is re-exported here” uses an explicitly banned term, and the remainder discusses namespaces, imports, umbrellas, and dependencies. Replace the paragraph with, for example, “This module also provides the controlled-unitary results used in the QPBT development,” or drop it.

**F7.** Replace “of a `CombinedPointsWitness`” with “of the combined point measurements of `lem:qld-4-10`.” The duplicate comments “exceeds the default limit” are runtime terminology; replace them with mathematical wording such as “The direct expansion of the nested finite sums and projector products is lengthy,” or drop them.

**F8.** Replace `SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add`, `nonencodingMarginalMass_le`, and `consistencyDefect` in prose with “the codeword-defect comparison,” “the non-encoding marginal-mass bound,” and “the bipartite consistency defect,” respectively.

The prior-round finding is resolved: the conditioned-defect theorem now has a separate, signature-faithful node. I found no quantifier, hypothesis, conclusion, indexing, or notation mismatch among the newly linked declarations, and the existing `\notready` statuses remain appropriate.

Summary: 0 equivalence mismatches, 2 blueprint-coverage findings covering 4 declarations, 3 dependency-annotation findings, and 3 prose findings.
